title: 第3章 碎骨第4章 小刀解惑
lines: “白痴！”小刀不屑的道：”你与常人不同，所以所修的武道也会异于常人，我说过，你还有选择的机会！要么选择相信我，要么就继续做你的废物吧！”
“好！我信你！但你要保证我不会被自己砸死！”要不那确实就太憋屈了。
话音刚落，萧羽顺手抄起手边的石头就向自己已经断裂的双腿砸去！
小刀，看着也是眼皮一跳，果然够狠，和他老子真像！若不这样，你将会完全没有资格救回你的爹娘！
“啊~~啊~~”惨叫声在后山整整响彻了一个晚上，期间有巡山弟子查看，吓得连滚带爬，逃离而去！
因为萧羽的样子实在是太惨了，最后连萧家家主和诸位久不露面的长老都惊动了。
“这个孩子还真是刚烈，没想到他会用这样的方法结束自己的生命！”大长老萧峰戚戚然道。
萧海看了好久已经成了一团肉泥的萧羽叹了口气：“在这里好好厚葬他，谁也不许再来惊扰！”
留下这样一句话，转身飘然而去。
不久，萧家萧羽，因为不堪受辱，精神错乱最终用石头将自己活活砸死的事情再次传遍了整个青山镇！
落日山脉，一座充满灵气的山峰上，一位身着白色纱裙，盘膝坐在一棵古树的树冠之上，手上古琴，随着一双纤手的拨动，时而飘渺，时而磅礴，如云，似风，像雨，一幅自然的画卷，透过琴音就可以让人感受！
“嘻嘻，姐姐，又在一个人弹琴？你这琴技是越来越好了，就是不知道以后哪家公子能够有幸聆听呢！”
女子听闻娇羞的呵斥道：“你个小蹄子，哪里来的这些个龌龊话！”
转而女子问道：“最近外面可有什么有趣的事情发生？”
“有啊有啊，据山里的那些小老鼠回来说，青山镇萧家子孙出了个不能修炼的废物，然后呢关家小姐悔婚嫁给了吴家的少主吴峰，萧家的小子，不堪受辱自杀了。”
“这算什么有趣的事情？不过是强者逼死弱者罢了”
“姐姐，你可知道，这废物萧羽是怎么死的？”
“他是用石头把自己砸了一个晚上，把自己活活砸死了！”
“还真是一个有傲骨的男儿！”女子有些动容的道
“你二姐，三姐在做什么？”女子问道。
“还不是天天修炼，烦都烦死了。不知道我们什么时候可以走出这个封禁啊？”娇小活泼的女子怨声道。
“不知，十八年前，老主人将我们托付给树爷爷照顾我们，并留下封禁，只有少主人来到这里，打开封禁，我们才可以走出去！
我们只须提升修为等待即可，你切不可继续贪玩，要努力修炼，一旦少主人出现，我们一定要保护他的安危！”
“切~要是少主人找不到这里，老主人也不回来，我们岂不是永远出不去了？”少女不以为然的回道.....
萧羽，不严格来说是肉泥，在夜晚的时候会发现它的身上会点点星光闪现，似乎是天上的繁星，在一点一点的融入到他已经完全破碎的身体中，而随着星光的没入，宛如肉泥般的身体竟然以肉眼可见的速度在恢复。
萧羽的识海中，一道声音正在破口大骂：”你个混蛋，老子的身体都快长蛆了，你才教给我恢复之法？“
小刀幽幽的回道：”谁叫你下手那么快，那么狠了，我还没来得及说，你已经几十石头砸下去了！“
其实小刀没有说的是
“老子也不知道，你到底能不能活过来，只有星辰之体，才可以在你身体达到极限的时候引动星辰之力，毕竟只有星族之人才可以引动星辰之力，锻体，看来你还是继承了你母亲的血脉啊！
就是不知道你父亲的血脉你又继承了多少？”
九天以后，萧羽猛然张开了眼睛，坐了起来。
“啊~~~”突然一声高亢的尖叫声响起，原来是萧羽几日不见的小侍女！
“少爷，你现在是~~~”
“我是人，愣着干什么，还不快去准备一桶热水，我要洗澡。”
听到此话，小侍女连忙起身向外跑去。
“对了，再准备些吃的。”
小侍女连忙应“是”
萧羽此时从地上一跃而起，紧紧握了握双拳，感受到了体内澎湃的力量和强大的气血之力，猛然向身侧的一块大石头轰去
“砰~”石头应声而碎。
一种畅快淋漓的感觉从心底悠然而生。

content_en:
"Idiot!" Xiao Dao said disdainfully: "You are different from ordinary people, so the martial arts you practice will be different from ordinary people. I said, you still have a chance to choose! Either choose to believe me, or continue to be your trash!"
"Okay! I believe you! But you have to promise that I won't be smashed to death by myself!" Otherwise, it would really be too frustrating.
As soon as he finished speaking, Xiao Yu picked up the stone at hand and threw it at his broken legs!
Xiao Dao, his eyelids twitched when he saw it, he was really cruel, he looked exactly like me! If not, you will be completely unqualified to save your parents!
"Ah~~ah~~" The screams resounded throughout the whole night in the back mountain. During this period, some mountain patrol disciples checked and were so frightened that they rolled over and fled away!
Because Xiao Yu's appearance was so miserable that even the head of the Xiao family and the elders who had not shown up for a long time were alarmed.
"This child is really strong. I never thought he would end his life in such a way!" the great elder Xiao Feng said with emotion.
Xiao Hai looked at Xiao Yu who had turned into a ball of flesh for a long time and sighed: "Bury him properly here, and no one is allowed to disturb him again!"
Leaving such a sentence behind, he turned around and drifted away.
Soon, news spread throughout Qingshan Town that Xiao Yu, a member of the Xiao family, became insane and stoned himself to death because he could not bear the humiliation!
In the Sunset Mountains, on a mountain full of spiritual energy, a person wearing a white gauze skirt sits cross-legged on the crown of an ancient tree, holding a guqin. With the playing of a pair of delicate hands, sometimes it is misty, sometimes majestic, like clouds, like wind, like rain, a natural picture, which can be felt through the sound of the piano!
"Hehe, sister, are you playing the piano alone again? Your piano skills are getting better and better, but I don't know which young master will be lucky enough to listen to it in the future!"
Upon hearing this, the woman scolded shyly: "You little hooves, where did you get these dirty words from!"
The woman then asked, "Has anything interesting happened outside recently?"
"Yes, yes. According to the reports from those little mice in the mountains, a descendant of the Xiao family in Qingshan Town was a loser who couldn't cultivate. Then Miss Guan family regretted her marriage and married Wu Feng, the young master of the Wu family. The Xiao family boy couldn't bear the humiliation and committed suicide."
"What kind of interesting thing is this? It's just the strong forcing the weak to death."
"Sister, do you know how this good-for-nothing Xiao Yu died?"
"Oh?"
"He hit himself with rocks all night and beat himself to death!"
"He is really a proud man!" the woman said with some emotion.
"What are your second and third sisters doing?" the woman asked.
"I'm tired of not practicing every day. I wonder when we can get out of this ban?" the petite and lively woman complained.
"I don't know, eighteen years ago, the old master entrusted us to Grandpa Shu to take care of us and left a ban. Only when the young master comes here and opens the ban can we go out!
We just need to improve our cultivation and wait. You must not continue to play and practice hard. Once the young master appears, we must protect his safety! "
"Tch~ If the young master can't find this place and the old master doesn't come back, won't we never be able to get out?" the girl replied disapprovingly...
Xiao Yu, not strictly speaking, is meat. At night, you will find stars flashing on his body. It seems like the stars in the sky are gradually integrating into his completely broken body. As the starlight disappears, the body that looks like meat is recovering at a speed visible to the naked eye.
In Xiao Yu's sea of ​​consciousness, a voice was yelling: "You bastard, my body is almost covered with maggots, and you taught me how to recover?"
Xiaodao replied faintly: "Who told you to strike so quickly and so cruelly? Before I had time to say anything, you had already hit me with dozens of stones!"
In fact, what Xiaodao didn’t say is
"I don't know if you can survive. Only the body of the stars can activate the power of the stars when your body reaches its limit. After all, only people from the Star Clan can activate the power of the stars and forge the body. It seems that you have inherited your mother's bloodline!
I just don’t know how much of your father’s bloodline you have inherited? "
Nine days later, Xiao Yu suddenly opened his eyes and sat up.
"Ah~~~" Suddenly a high-pitched scream sounded. It turned out to be Xiao Yu's little maid whom he hadn't seen for a few days!
"Master, you are now~~~"
"I'm a human being. Why are you standing there? Why don't you prepare a bucket of hot water? I want to take a shower."
Upon hearing this, the little maid quickly got up and ran outside.
"By the way, prepare some more food."
The little maid quickly responded "Yes"
Xiao Yu jumped up from the ground at this time, clenched his fists tightly, felt the surging power and powerful energy and blood in his body, and suddenly blasted towards a big rock beside him.
"Bang~" The stone shattered in response.
A refreshing feeling emerged from the bottom of my heart.
